name: Google Books
label: Google Books
description: Google Books official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: volume_search, volume_get, bookshelf_list, bookshelf_get. Docs: https://developers.google.com/books/docs/v1/using. Google APIs Terms. API key (query key=) for public volumes. OAuth required for private bookshelves (not in this OfficialApiNode v1). Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Google Books request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"volume_search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: volume_search | volume_get | bookshelf_list | bookshelf_get. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'volume_search'.

schema.label: langRestrict
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `langRestrict` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: maxResults
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `maxResults` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: shelf_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `shelf_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: startIndex
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `startIndex` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `user_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: volume_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `volume_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: Print type
schema.description: volumes.list printType. EXACT: all | books | magazines. volume_search.

schema.label: Order by
schema.description: volumes.list orderBy. EXACT: relevance | newest. volume_search.

schema.label: Filter
schema.description: volumes.list filter. EXACT: partial | full | free-ebooks | paid-ebooks | ebooks. volume_search.

schema.label: Projection
schema.description: volumes projection. EXACT: full | lite. volume_search / volume_get.

schema.label: Download
schema.description: volumes.list download=epub restricts to EPUB. volume_search.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: volume_search | volume_get | bookshelf_list | bookshelf_get. Example: 'volume_search'.

configurationParameters.label: Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
